result.headline: Pitch responded opposite to its command early on; ch[3] jumped to 1900 us at 55.238 s and pitch tracking degraded afterwards.
result.explanation: Two control anomalies: pitch moved opposite to its setpoint at t=0-7 s (correlation -0.988 at 0.969 s lag), and ch[3] stepped to 1900 us at 55.238 s before pitch tracking degraded. Data cannot separate polarity, sensor and actuator faults.

next_action.action: Check pitch control-surface direction and ch[2] and ch[3] mapping on the ground
next_action.why: Separates a reversed pitch mixer or servo from an attitude-sensor fault, and checks whether ch[3] can physically reach 1900 us.
how: With props off, command pitch-down in stabilize mode and note the direction of elevator or elevon motion.
Compare that direction with the PWM on ch[2] (and ch[4]/ch[5]) and with the pitch reported by the attitude estimate.
Tilt the airframe nose-up by hand and confirm the reported pitch sign.
Command ch[3] toward 1900 us and check that the servo moves freely without binding.
next_action.conditions: On the ground, power connected, propeller removed, flight controller in a mode that outputs surface commands. Battery at a normal charge level.
next_action.baseline: The recorded pitch setpoint against pitch response and ch[2] in t=0-7 s (lines 74, 32).
